newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 9c to 584c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 9c to 584c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose nine cents to 584 cents a kg clean on Thursday in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were dearer, with the 19 micron indicator up 0.5 percent.
The 20m category was 1.0 percent dearer, while 21/22/24m were 2.0 percent dearer. The 23/26m categories were 2.5 percent dearer and 25m was 1.5 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/28/31m were 1.0 percent dearer and 29/30m were 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were generally unchanged, locks slightly dearer and crutchings generally unchanged, WI said.
WI said Japan, China, Taiwan and South Korea were all active with good support from Western Europe.
Of the 20,093 bales offered, 3.6 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney and Geelong with about 59,000 bales to be offered.
